messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Art. 26(2)

Article 26 Transposition. 2. Member States shall communicate to the Commission the text of the provisions of national law which they adopt in the field covered by this Directive, together with a table showing how the provisions of this Directive correspond to the national provisions adopted.

response.text:
Member States | communicateToCommission | text of national law provisions adopted in the field covered by this Directive | "" | "Member States shall communicate to the Commission the text of the provisions of national law which they adopt in the field covered by this Directive"
Member States | submitCorrespondenceTable | table showing how Directive provisions correspond to adopted national provisions | "" | "together with a table showing how the provisions of this Directive correspond to the national provisions adopted"
